pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, input fields, inverse text on dark surfaces

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary text, headlines, body copy, nav links — near-black warmth over pure black

true-black.$description: True Black — Logo mark fill, select borders, deep shadow tone

hairline.$description: Hairline — Borders, dividers, outlined control strokes, card edges

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary card surfaces, disabled button fills, subtle elevation layers

cream-stone.$description: Cream Stone — Warm accent card surface — the only chromatic neutral, used for editorial feature cards

muted.$description: Muted — Secondary link color, meta text, subdued captions

dim.$description: Dim — Tertiary text, low-priority helper copy

disabled.$description: Disabled — Disabled button backgrounds, inactive control fills

electric-yellow.$description: Electric Yellow — Announcement bar, single chromatic accent across the system — the only color permitted to break monochrome

ui-sans-serif.$description: ui-sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

suisse-intl.$description: Primary brand typeface for headlines, navigation, body, and UI. The 55px display at line-height 1.10 with -0.015em tracking is the signature voice — editorial weight, magazine-tight rhythm. Weight 500 is reserved for nav links and select emphasis.

system-sans-serif.$description: Secondary UI text, system fallbacks, form labels. Used sparingly — Suisse Intl is the workhorse. System stack appears for form fields and accessibility fallbacks where neutral rendering matters.
